summary: Implementation plan to upgrade both the MarginWatch frontend documentation suite (docs/frontend/*.md) and the live interactive application (src/*) to the Electric Indigo (#6558D3), Soft Cloud (#F6F7F9), and Midnight Slate (#202633) visual design system with Inter + JetBrains Mono typography, 12-16px card radii, subtle developer-tool aesthetics, and full 320px-1920px responsive specifications.
